stories.title: A helping of hope: Raul Jimenez Thanksgiving Dinner brings San Antonio together for 47th year
stories.summary: Volunteers are preparing thousands of free meals at the Henry B. González Convention Center, where everyone is welcome to share food, friendship and holiday cheer.

stories.title: Man accused of killing woman in front of her four children also faces child sexual assault charge
stories.summary: Michael Anthony Jones, 41, is accused of fatally shooting a mother of four just days after a warrant was issued for his arrest in a child sexual assault case.

stories.title: Silver Alert discontinued for 82-year-old man last seen in San Antonio on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: The alert has been discontinued as Texas DPS says the man has been found.

stories.title: A lifetime of memories, a word of thanks: Stone Oak seniors share their gratitude
stories.summary: Residents at VIVERE Life Stone Oak reflect on what matters most, sharing simple messages of gratitude shaped by a lifetime of experiences.

stories.title: A new home, then a fight to recover: Kerrville rescue helps dog who fell from bridge
stories.summary: Kerrville Pets Alive! funded emergency care for a recently adopted dog after a fall from the Sidney Baker Bridge. Donations are needed for her treatment.

stories.title: Have you seen Elliana? Bexar County deputies seek help finding missing 17-year-old
stories.summary: Elliana Zertuche was last seen walking on Talley Road on Nov. 23, wearing a red cutoff shirt and “Stitch” pajama pants.

stories.title: Here, everything’s better: H-E-B offers holiday savings to help fill the family table
stories.summary: From a Thanksgiving feast for 10 for less than $35 to thousands of coupons, H-E-B is offering ways to stretch holiday budgets and make room for celebration.

stories.title: Driver booked for DWI after barrier crash leads to second collision on Loop 410, police say
stories.summary: A passenger was hospitalized in stable condition after a second vehicle collided with a car stopped on the highway near Ingram Road.

stories.title: Driver caught after pickup hits woman and leaves scene on FM 78, police say
stories.summary: A 61-year-old woman was hospitalized in stable condition after the Wednesday evening crash. Police located the driver shortly afterward.

stories.title: Driver killed after speeding car hits Mustang stopped at red light, police say
stories.summary: Police say the other driver showed signs of impairment after the Thanksgiving morning crash on Bandera Road.

stories.title: Woman takes gun from suspect after man is shot during fight, police say
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man was shot in the torso on Glen Ridge. Police say a woman disarmed the suspect before officers arrived.

stories.title: Man shot outside northwest side apartment during family’s pre-Thanksgiving gathering
stories.summary: Police say a stranger pushed the man and shot him in the leg before fleeing in a pickup. The victim was hospitalized in stable condition.
